integrity: Original claims are confined to the mixed homology character computed by the weighted parity-orbit formula. Prior Boolean-model and nonequivariant homotopy theorems are credited. Exact finite checks corroborate, rather than replace, the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies reduced rational homology characters for the canonical neighborhood-duality involution and coordinate permutations, not integral module splittings, all graph automorphisms, or an equivariant homotopy type. Some unindexed literature may cover an equivalent mixed-character formula.
title: Duality-twisted homology characters of all Kneser neighborhood complexes
